end.note: Find a stronghold (throw eyes, ~2 used up), fill the portal frame (12 eyes worst case; each frame block already holds an eye with p=0.1).

nether.note: Build a 4x5 obsidian frame (10 without corners) and light it.

interactions.note: Right-click any water source; water is everywhere in the overworld.
Lava pools (lake_lava features) on the surface or underground; easier in the nether.
Pour water over a lava source, mine the obsidian (diamond pickaxe or better).
Place lava from a bucket, pour water on it, mine.
Use a bucket on a cow (or goat).
Water bottle (a potion item with the water potion component).
Build and kill the wither; its loot table gives the nether star.
